title: Cambridge IELTS 16 Test 4 Writing Task 2
directions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
prompt: Do you think the advantages of driverless vehicles outweigh the disadvantages?
scenario: In the future all cars, buses and trucks will be driverless. The only people travelling inside these vehicles will be passengers.
requirements: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
